question: For what purpose was Pūrṇaśaila’s origin said to occur in relation to Kali’s sin?
premises: There is terrible sin of the Kali age.
The purpose stated is its destruction.
inference: Pūrṇaśaila’s origin serves to destroy the terrible sin of the Kali age.
plain_english: O great goddess, it was for the destruction of the terrible sin of the Kali age.
